task: Adjudication of all preserved pnpm ast viewgap candidates

method.consumer_method: Read each declaration/producer and relevant current consumers; corroborated field-name searches with actual ast-grep property-access sweeps.
method.tests: No behavioral suite run; this was static adjudication and the task prohibited duplicating heavy test lanes.

tool_defects.detail: The lens treats every interface named *View/*Summary under contracts or server as client-facing, then checks only packages/client/src. Internal server summaries therefore become guaranteed false positives.
Shared cross-boundary MessageView fields can have load-bearing server consumers; a client-only reader census misses them.
The lens and structural sweeps are name-based, so common names such as contentHash, parentChatId, and automationDepth need owner/type adjudication. A raw hit count is not a reader proof.

bounded_tool_calibration: Restrict candidates to DTO owners explicitly marked client-facing, or select result types reachable from client router outputs instead of all *View/*Summary names.
For server-owned candidate types, include packages/server production property reads before emitting a gap.
Report whole-object pass-through and type/name ambiguity as lower-confidence evidence; do not label a name absence as dead code.
